implementationState: Application source committed at0e56ca0 on refinement/post-review-completion; static capability inventory, not a release or per-flow runtime approval.
scope: Current source inventory. Route patterns, exported HTTP methods, Expo file routes/layouts, source modules, direct assistant tools and curated operations are counted separately. Static presence does not establish authorization, usable UI, provider readiness or native-device behavior; see capability-matrix.md, post-review.md and post-review-catalog.md.

countDefinitions.apiPaths: Route patterns under src/app/api; catch-all auth counts once, not as every library subendpoint.
countDefinitions.apiMethods: Explicit exported HTTP handlers in those route modules, including aliases/re-exports; framework implicit HEAD/OPTIONS are not added.
countDefinitions.auxiliaryRoutePaths: App route handlers outside /api, listed separately from APIs and pages.
countDefinitions.webPages: page.ts/tsx files; excludes layouts, components and route handlers.
countDefinitions.nativeRoutes: All Expo Router .ts/.tsx route-tree source files, including _layout; retained compatibility name.
countDefinitions.nativeScreenRoutes: Expo route-tree files excluding _layout; file-based routes, not a claim of unique native features or runtime validation.
countDefinitions.nativeScreenSources: Files under mobile/src/screens, including shared screen helpers; not an additional route count.
countDefinitions.services: Files under src/lib/services; not individual exported functions or user operations.
countDefinitions.providers: Files under src/lib/providers; not configured/ready upstream providers.
countDefinitions.domains: Files under src/lib/domain; not distinct features.
countDefinitions.serverActionModules: Source modules containing a use server directive; normal services and route handlers are not counted as React server actions.
countDefinitions.directAssistantTools: Top-level AI_ASSISTANT_TOOLS declarations; read_app_data and prepare_app_actions dispatch to the separate curated catalog.
countDefinitions.curatedOperations: APP_OPERATIONS declarations, grouped by their explicit effect rather than HTTP verb. Not additive to direct tool count.
countDefinitions.integrationPaths: Explicit API-key route allowlist patterns in integrationRoutes; method values are resource/action permissions, not side effects.
countDefinitions.boundaryCalls: Selected named helper calls found syntactically in each route module. Empty lists do not imply an unguarded route; indirect/library checks and service authorization require connected review.

historicalInventory.meaning: Previous full-project inventory reference only; not a test receipt for this working tree.

evidence.note: Final verification and external limits are in post-review-verification.md. Static presence is separate from each workflow acceptance status.
